title: Cardiac ICU Patient Admission
description: Standard procedure for admitting patients to the Cardiac Intensive Care Unit

steps.description: Verify patient identity and admission order
steps.details: Check patient wristband, confirm full name, DOB, and MRN. Verify physician admission order in EHR system.
validation_criteria: Patient identity confirmed with two identifiers
Admission order signed by attending physician
warnings: Do not proceed without proper identification

steps.description: Obtain and document baseline vital signs
steps.details: Measure blood pressure, heart rate, respiratory rate, temperature, and oxygen saturation. Document in patient chart.
validation_criteria: All vital signs within acceptable ranges or documented abnormalities
warnings: Alert physician immediately if vital signs are unstable
Ensure ECG leads are properly placed

steps.details: List all current medications including dosage and frequency. Check for drug interactions and allergies.
warnings: Pay special attention to anticoagulants and cardiac medications

steps.description: Establish IV access and initiate monitoring
steps.details: Insert appropriate IV line (minimum 18G for cardiac patients). Connect to cardiac monitor and pulse oximetry.
validation_criteria: Cardiac monitoring active with clear waveforms
warnings: Use sterile technique for IV insertion
Verify alarm settings before leaving bedside

steps.details: Perform comprehensive nursing assessment including cardiac, respiratory, neurological, and skin assessment. Document in EHR.
validation_criteria: All body systems assessed and documented
Risk assessments completed (fall risk, pressure injury, etc.)

steps.description: Notify care team and complete handoff
steps.details: Notify attending physician, charge nurse, and other team members. Complete SBAR handoff communication.
